definition.text: buy: the sweep candle takes a confirmed, untouched H1 swing low (3 a side, last 96 candles; the most recent one taken) while the partner index, on its own candles up to and including the sweep candle, never trades below its lowest low of the swing's 7-candle window; sells mirror. GC excluded (no clean partner: silver is paper only)

costs: lab COST round trip: NQ 1.5, ES 0.5, YM 3, RTY 0.4 points; net R = size x (R - cost / risk); live sizing (sizeOf); 2x costs = 2 x net - gross; no financing (trades last at most 36 H1 candles; the desk trades futures)
multipleTesting: Holm over T1 (monthly-sum t, one-sided), T2 (one-sided Welch OOS), T3 (one-sided Welch IS)
